events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in Bethel, New York, in August 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love Echoes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for peace and music. What's your ultimate festival anthem from the era?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away at Graceland on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day in '77, we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. His music lives on. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar. His legacy is undeniable. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. The album cover alone is legendary! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' in October 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally. What does it mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Remember The iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film's premiere.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on his birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your all-time favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. So much incredible music across two discs! What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: We remember Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
